canvas-mist.$description: Canvas Mist — Page background and secondary surface wash behind elevated cards

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Primary surface for cards, input fields, floating brand spotlights, and pill buttons

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, headings, icons, nav symbols, and dark mode product cards

faint-border.$description: Faint Border — Hairline dividers on cards, input outlines, and pill button borders

muted-gray.$description: Muted Gray — Secondary text, navigation labels, icon strokes in idle state

cool-stone.$description: Cool Stone — Placeholder fills, disabled states, and inactive icon backgrounds

warm-fog.$description: Warm Fog — Subtle surface tints for secondary product cards and section backgrounds

shop-violet.$description: Shop Violet — Search submit button, wordmark dot, brand logo — the single accent that makes action and identity pop against the white canvas

violet-wash.$description: Violet Wash — Translucent halo behind the violet submit button, extending its glow without changing hue

slate-ink.$description: Slate Ink — Dark product card surfaces and deep-tone overlay text

ash-veil.$description: Ash Veil — Warm desaturated gray used in product imagery backdrops, not an active UI token

gt-standard.$description: Primary typeface at all sizes — body and headings alike. GTStandard-MRegular at 16px/-0.031em is the workhorse for body, buttons, and labels. GTStandard-MSemibold at 20px/-0.05em powers the few display-scale headings; GTStandard-MMedium at 11–12px handles micro-labels. Every weight renders at 400 optical weight — the font family carries its hierarchy through subtle grade shifts and tight negative tracking, not bold contrast. This is the signature: Shop doesn't shout with bold, it shapes text with tracking.

shopify-sans.$description: Reserved for system-level messaging like the app download banner and cookie consent copy
